m1-tag-staleness.title: Fix 1: watch tags for staleness independent of anchors
m1-tag-staleness.imperative: Extend extract.py so the staleness mechanism covers tag statements as first-class subjects, without touching span_hash's body, anchor(), or the anchored diff (extend alongside). Persist a span_hash on tag emission (track an enclosing-node stack alongside self.encl so a statement-level tag hashes its ENCLOSING entity's span, matching the whole-entity case where the tag's own node already is that span). Identity for a tag across two extractions is (owning symbol, tag text) -- no slug exists for a tag. Diff old-vs-new tag hashes the same way anchors are diffed (read previous 'tag' rows before this run's write overwrites the store), emit a new 'stale-tag' statement when the enclosing body hash changed while the (sym, text) key matched, and wire render.py's load_stores() to intercept p=='stale-tag' into the SAME stale_tags list/ADVISORY channel g6 established (report.get('stale_tags') and the 'ADVISORY stale tag' print) -- no second reporting channel. Add a fixture entity carrying a tag and NO anchor at all; write the test RED first (it must fail because the mechanism does not exist yet), then make it pass. Fix or split CommentTagStaleAnchorJoinTests so its docstring stops claiming a join it does not demonstrate (its fixture has both an anchor and a tag, so it proves coexistence, not the tag mechanism alone). Then attack your own work: temporarily delete the new tag-flag emission and confirm the new tag-only test goes red; report exactly which test(s) failed; revert and confirm green again.

m3-pin-widen.imperative: Build a shared AST-walk helper that flags an explicit if/elif compare on kind (as today), a dict/mapping lookup keyed by kind that dispatches to something OTHER than the tag's own fields (not a bare read like t['kind']), and a match statement on kind. Use it in both test_comment_tags_render_path_carries_no_branch_on_kind and test_comment_tags_cull_verdict_collapse_kinds_have_no_render_dependency. Verify by writing a real evading mutation (a dict-lookup dispatch in a scratch copy of tag_lines) and watching the OLD Compare-only check pass it and the NEW widened check catch it -- do not reason about it, run it. Revert any temporary mutation; tag_lines itself must not change (fix 2's constraint).
